## Security Review

- [ ] I ran the security-reviewer pass or documented why it is not applicable.
- [ ] I reviewed authentication, authorization, tenancy, secrets, audit, and data-retention impact.
- [ ] I updated SSP/POA&M evidence when the change affects a control.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for security-relevant behavior.

## Verification

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] OPA policy tests, when policy changed
- [ ] Portal build/tests, when UI changed
